cond_0001.intro: The Laboratory Operations Manager (CLS Kitting) will use their expertise in central laboratory operations to oversee the execution of clinical trials kitting projects for multiple clinical studies supporting clients engaged in research. This role involves close collaboration with leaders from Project Management, Logistics, Business Development, Proposals, Procurement, and Finance teams to ensure efficient resource utilization and adherence to agreed-upon timelines. The ideal candidate will have direct experience managing clinical trials central lab operations, along with a working knowledge of regulatory guidance and industry best practices. They will also contribute to short and long-term financial forecasting for the Kit Production team within Central Lab Services Management.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:
Collaborate with Project Management, Logistics, Business Development, Proposals, Procurement, and Finance teams to prioritize and communicate daily activities for team members, ensuring timely kit preparation and delivery to meet client demands. Act as a liaison between cross-functional business groups to support task organization from project award to delivery, addressing any identified gaps that may impact scheduled study deliverables. Manage operational scheduling and forecasting for Kit production, coordinating with relevant teams to forecast work across all projects. Assist in project planning related to schedule kit production, considering factors such as kit component availability and staffing constraints. Work with the Financial Project Analyst to update the scheduling tool (e.g., [Product name masked]) with newly awarded work and change orders, ensuring accurate billing activities. Coordinate change orders and scope of work amendments with Project Managers and Financial Project Analysts to identify additional support needed for lab activities. Establish appropriate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics for the Kit Production teams, monitoring and reporting trends to stakeholders. Supervise and mentor team members to ensure efficient workflow and high-quality outputs. Perform other duties/projects as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in a related field and a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in operational management of central lab services functions and cross-functional operational project management.
Solid understanding of current GLP, GCP, or GCLP standards.
Strong oral and written communication skills.
Understanding of operational workflow including kitting, quality control, study set-up, and deliverables.
Fluent English language skills in reading, writing, speaking, and comprehension.
Preferred Requirements
Working knowledge of CAP/CLIA and ISO 9001.
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and [Product name masked].

cond_0291.intro: The Laboratory Operations Manager (CLS Kitting) will use their background in central laboratory operations to oversee the execution of clinical trials kitting projects for multiple clinical studies supporting clients engaged in cutting-edge research. This role entails close collaboration with leaders from Project Management, Logistics, Business Development, Proposals, Procurement, and Finance teams to ensure efficient resource utilization and adherence to agreed-upon timelines. The ideal candidate will have direct experience in managing clinical trials central lab operations, along with a working knowledge of regulatory guidance and industry best practices. Additionally, they will contribute to short and long-term financial forecasting for the Kit Production team within Central Lab Services Management.
cond_0291.responsibilities:
Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:
Collaborate with Project Management, Logistics, Business Development, Proposals, Procurement, and Finance teams to prioritize and communicate daily activities for team members, ensuring timely kit preparation and delivery to meet client demands. Act as a liaison between cross-functional business groups to support task organization from project award to delivery, addressing any identified gaps that may impact scheduled study deliverables. Manage operational scheduling and forecasting for Kit production, coordinating with relevant teams to forecast work across all projects. Assist in project planning related to schedule kit production, considering factors such as kit component availability and staffing constraints. Work with the Financial Project Analyst to update the scheduling tool (e.g., [Product name masked]) with newly awarded work and change orders, ensuring accurate billing activities. Coordinate change orders and scope of work amendments with Project Managers and Financial Project Analysts to identify additional support needed for lab activities. Establish appropriate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics for the Kit Production teams, monitoring and reporting trends to stakeholders. Supervise and mentor team members to ensure efficient workflow and high-quality outputs. Perform other duties/projects as assigned.
cond_0291.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with around 3 years of relevant experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Background in operational management of central lab services functions and cross-functional operational project management.
Familiarity with current GLP, GCP, or GCLP standards.
Working knowledge of CAP/CLIA and ISO 9001.
Ability to communicate effectively in English, both in writing and verbally.
Physical ability to lift and carry weights ranging from 1–50 lbs. And work in cold freezer environments.
Preferred Requirements
Exposure to operational workflow including kitting, quality control, study set-up, and deliverables.
Comfort with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and [Product name masked].
Ability to work independently with attention to detail.
Willingness to learn and adapt in a productive work environment.

The ideal candidate will have direct experience in managing clinical trials central lab operations, along with a working knowledge of regulatory guidance and industry best practices. They will also contribute to short and long-term financial forecasting for the Kit Production team within Central Lab Services Management.
cond_0342.responsibilities:
Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:
Coordinate with Project Management, Logistics, Business Development, Proposals, Procurement, and Finance teams to prioritize and communicate daily activities for team members, ensuring timely kit preparation and delivery to meet client demands. Serve as a liaison between cross-functional business groups to support task organization from project award to delivery, helping to address any identified gaps that may impact scheduled study deliverables. Work with relevant teams to manage operational scheduling and forecasting for Kit production across all projects. Assist in project planning related to scheduled kit production, taking into account factors such as kit component availability and staffing constraints. Work with the Financial Project Analyst to keep the scheduling tool (e.g., [Product name masked]) updated with newly awarded work and change orders, helping to ensure accurate billing activities. Coordinate change orders and scope of work amendments with Project Managers and Financial Project Analysts to identify additional support needed for lab activities. Establish appropriate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics for the Kit Production teams, and share trends and findings with stakeholders. Support and mentor team members to help ensure efficient workflow and high-quality outputs. Perform other duties/projects as assigned.
cond_0342.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in a related field and a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in operational management of central lab services functions and cross-functional operational project management.
Solid understanding of current GLP, GCP, or GCLP standards.
Working knowledge of CAP/CLIA and ISO 9001.
Strong oral and written communication skills.
Understanding of operational workflow including kitting, quality control, study set-up, and deliverables.
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and [Product name masked].
Ability to thrive in a highly productive work environment.
Ability to work independently with attention to detail.

The ideal candidate will possess direct experience in managing clinical trials central lab operations, along with a working knowledge of regulatory guidance and industry best practices. Additionally, they will contribute to short and long-term financial forecasting for the Kit Production team within Central Lab Services Management.
cond_0371.responsibilities:
Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:
Collaborate with Project Management, Logistics, Business Development, Proposals, Procurement, and Finance teams to prioritize and communicate daily activities for team members, ensuring timely kit preparation and delivery to meet client demands. Act as a liaison between cross-functional business groups to support task organization from project award to delivery, addressing any identified gaps that may impact scheduled study deliverables. Manage operational scheduling and forecasting for Kit production, coordinating with relevant teams to forecast work across all projects. Assist in project planning related to schedule kit production, considering factors such as kit component availability and staffing constraints. Work with the Financial Project Analyst to update the scheduling tool (e.g., [Product name masked]) with newly awarded work and change orders, ensuring accurate billing activities. Coordinate change orders and scope of work amendments with Project Managers and Financial Project Analysts to identify additional support needed for lab activities. Establish appropriate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics for the Kit Production teams, monitoring and reporting trends to stakeholders. Supervise and mentor team members to ensure efficient workflow and high-quality outputs. Perform other duties/projects as assigned.
cond_0371.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred, with a minimum of 3 years of demonstrated expertise in a relevant discipline or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Proven track record in operational management of central lab services functions and cross-functional operational project management.
Advanced knowledge of current GLP, GCP, or GCLP standards.
Solid understanding of CAP/CLIA and ISO 9001.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills.
Deep knowledge of operational workflow including kitting, quality control, study set-up, and deliverables.
Strong command of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and [Product name masked].
Ability to work independently with strong attention to detail in a highly productive work environment.
Physical ability to lift and carry weights ranging from 1-50 lbs., may be exposed to cold freezer environments.
Fluent English language skills in reading, writing, speaking, and comprehension.

This role involves regular, close collaboration with leaders from Project Management, Logistics, Business Development, Proposals, Procurement, and Finance teams to ensure efficient resource utilization and adherence to agreed-upon timelines. The ideal candidate will have direct experience managing clinical trials central lab operations, along with a working knowledge of regulatory guidance and industry best practices. They will also contribute to short and long-term financial forecasting for the Kit Production team within Central Lab Services Management.
cond_0501.responsibilities:
Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:
Actively collaborate with Project Management, Logistics, Business Development, Proposals, Procurement, and Finance teams on a daily basis to prioritize and communicate activities for team members, ensuring timely kit preparation and delivery to meet client demands.
Act as a liaison between cross-functional business groups to support task organization from project award to delivery, speaking up early to address any identified gaps that may impact scheduled study deliverables.
Manage operational scheduling and forecasting for Kit production, regularly connecting with relevant teams to forecast work across all projects.
Assist in project planning related to scheduled kit production, considering factors such as kit component availability and staffing constraints.
Work closely with the Financial Project Analyst to update the scheduling tool (e.g., [Product name masked]) with newly awarded work and change orders, ensuring accurate billing activities.
Coordinate change orders and scope of work amendments with Project Managers and Financial Project Analysts, initiating discussions to identify additional support needed for lab activities.
Establish appropriate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics for the Kit Production teams, monitoring and reporting trends to stakeholders.
Supervise and mentor team members to ensure efficient workflow and high-quality outputs.
Perform other duties/projects as assigned.
cond_0501.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in a related field and a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in operational management of central lab services functions and cross-functional operational project management.
Solid understanding of current GLP, GCP, or GCLP standards.
Working knowledge of CAP/CLIA and ISO 9001.
Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain trade-offs and walk stakeholders through decisions.
Understanding of operational workflow including kitting, quality control, study set-up, and deliverables.
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and [Product name masked].
Able to work effectively in a busy, productive work environment.
Ability to work independently with attention to detail.
Physical ability to lift and carry weights ranging from 1-50 lbs., may be exposed to cold freezer environments.
Fluent English language skills in reading, writing, speaking, and comprehension.

The ideal candidate will have direct experience managing clinical trials central lab operations, along with a working knowledge of regulatory guidance and industry best practices. They will also contribute to short and long-term financial forecasting for the Kit Production team within Central Lab Services Management. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of central lab workflows and kitting operations.
cond_0616.responsibilities:
Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:
Collaborate with Project Management, Logistics, Business Development, Proposals, Procurement, and Finance teams to prioritize and communicate daily activities for team members, ensuring timely kit preparation and delivery to meet client demands. Act as a liaison between cross-functional business groups to support task organization from project award to delivery, addressing any identified gaps that may impact scheduled study deliverables. Manage operational scheduling and forecasting for Kit production, coordinating with relevant teams to forecast work across all projects. Assist in project planning related to schedule kit production, considering factors such as kit component availability and staffing constraints. Work with the Financial Project Analyst to update the scheduling tool (e.g., [Product name masked]) with newly awarded work and change orders, ensuring accurate billing activities. Coordinate change orders and scope of work amendments with Project Managers and Financial Project Analysts to identify additional support needed for lab activities. Establish appropriate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics for the Kit Production teams, monitoring and reporting trends to stakeholders. Supervise and mentor team members to ensure efficient workflow and high-quality outputs. Perform other duties/projects as assigned.
cond_0616.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in a related field and a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in operational management of central lab services functions and cross-functional operational project management.
Solid understanding of current GLP, GCP, or GCLP standards.
Strong oral and written communication skills.
Ability to work independently with attention to detail.
Physical ability to lift and carry weights ranging from 1-50 lbs., may be exposed to cold freezer environments.
Fluent English language skills in reading, writing, speaking, and comprehension.
Preferred Requirements
Working knowledge of CAP/CLIA and ISO 9001.
Understanding of operational workflow including kitting, quality control, study set-up, and deliverables.
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and [Product name masked].
Ability to work in a highly productive work environment.
cond_0616.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
